title: The HoneypotChecker deploy wrapper compares DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY and PRIVATE_KEY as raw strings, passes the whole environment (bot key included) to the Hardhat child, and the config sets no fee ceiling for Ignition deploys

evidence.note: refuses only when DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY === PRIVATE_KEY as strings: the same key with or without 0x, or in other letter case, passes, and Ignition then deploys from the bot wallet (its nonce shared with a running bot)

spawnSync npx hardhat ignition deploy ... --network <network> with env {...process.env} and shell: true: every secret in the parent env reaches the Hardhat child, which also loads .env itself (hardhat.config.ts:9)
DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY must be present (in .env or the shell); the log asks the operator to rotate it out of .env after the deploy
no ignition block (maxFeePerGasLimit / maxPriorityFeePerGas) and no per-network gasPrice: a deploy during a fee spike pays whatever the network asks

side effect: Ignition writes ignition/deployments/chain-<id>/ (journal.jsonl, artifacts, build-info, deployed_addresses.json); the operator pastes the address into .env by hand; a deploy interrupted part-way leaves a journal the next run resumes
module has no parameters and no follow-up calls: nothing else to configure

sibling_sites_checked: The other deploy-time scripts: audit-honeypot-checker.ts (read-only; Etherscan key in the query string over HTTPS, not printed; crash output is AUD-SCRIPTS-005) and deploySepoliaTest.ts (bot key, cannot load, AUD-SCRIPTS-001). The Ignition journal files are tracked since OD-21 (commit 93f8189); their line-ending hazard is AUD-OD21-001. The keystore question is card OD-22 (Phase 30).
severity_rationale: S3: an operator-run, interactive deploy (Ignition asks for confirmation on a live network); the weak key check matters only if the operator reuses the bot key in another spelling, and the missing fee cap only during a spike, each a bounded gas or capability-split effect.
recommendation: Phase 30 (with OD-22): compare the derived addresses (computeAddress of both keys), pass the Hardhat child only what it needs, and set ignition.maxFeePerGasLimit and maxPriorityFeePerGas in the deploy config.
